title: feat(ml): implement NLP complaint priority classifier, department routing pipeline, and model registry
author: SmartCity360 Architecture Team
problem: Municipal triage staff face severe cognitive bottlenecks manually evaluating incoming tickets, estimating resolution SLAs, and forwarding to appropriate civic departments.
solution: Built production NLP pipeline using scikit-learn (TF-IDF + balanced Logistic Regression) for priority triage (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW) and departmental routing (ROADS, SANITATION, ELECTRICAL, WATER). Persisted serialized joblib artifacts with validation manifests, implemented MLDecisionService singleton, integrated auto-triage into ComplaintService.create_complaint, and exposed /complaints/ai-triage and /complaints/models/registry endpoints.
security_considerations: Local offline scikit-learn models without external cloud inference or API keys; sanitized text tokenization; model registry audit trail.
